Between the mountain tops on Motra neighboring Filitrios. There is a hidden, well protected prison. The prison held prisoners off all sorts, the most dangerous ones were often shipped off to a higher level security prison such as Alcatras. Very few actually managed to escape the prison. Until it was invaded.

> Weather Conditions

Motra can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

If Motra is Eclipsed, the mortars will fire off four shots in quick succession instead of one.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Mortars

Motra has mortars as seen in the tape used to unlock the moon. These mortars aim towards the rough location of a random player outside and fire one shot at a time. These mortars can be turned off via a lever that is behind the ship, up the pathway to the right above the fire exit, and to left at the next intersection.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the Motra videotape found on Galetry into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Fission-C: Log "Radio message 1" found on the exterior.
Oldred: Log "Radio message 1" found on the exterior.
Dreck: Log "Floppy disk" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Alcatras: Log "Secret files" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Hyve: Hyve videotape that is found within the breakable hive that has a 33% chance to spawn on the exterior. It is accessible via a lone fire exit in the interior or a jetpack.
Filitrios: Filitrios videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Crowd: "Teach the disloyal" videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
ResearcherxB: Motra can be one of the random moons that requires placing a placing a Triangulation Device on its exterior.

> Lore

Radio Message 1

Text ⁠
Hello everyone, this is your favourite radio host from
-Across the stars-
It is currently 11:13 AM and it looks like the weather is quite upset today but lets not have that ruin our Mondays ey.

Unfortunately I have to be the bearer of bad news, we have had reports of an attack that happened on the Grand Capitol of Calist. As of now we are unsure of the severity of the attack but I'm sure we'll find out soon enough.

In some other news the nuclear power plants in the C sector of Fission have been closed down due to a failure to meet safety regulations.
Thank god for that,
That place sounded like you'd be glowing green from simply being there.
There have also been constructions sightings on the moon of Oldred, which is interesting considering that's about the single worst place to build literally anything.

Either way, that's it for me.
I've got some classic hits lined up for your usual monday madness so stay tuned. Thank you for listening to
-Across The Stars-

Motra Videotape

This videotape will always spawn within museum on Galetry and it also can be found on Filitrios and Polarus.

Text ⁠
Hi, it's harry with mighty mortor!
It's like a mortar but it's a mortor!
Mordor wouldn't have fallen with this mortar!

Regular defences don't work well.
People get their houses broken into all the time!
Burglars, thieves, your neighbors, nosy aunts, crazy exes, giants bees, nintendo, not even I will be able to break in with this thing in your backyard!

Normal mortars can only fire one shell at the time.
This thing can launch 30 of them within the blink of an eye!
Bet nobody expects that on their weather forecast!

You can put it in your backyard, put it on your car!
Attach it to your wallet, you'll spot it from afar!
You can even use it to collect water when you get deserted on an uninhabited island!

Mortors mortar, only 300.000 per piece!
But if you call now with in the next 20 minutes, we'll give you a second one absolutely free!
